newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 105,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 105,000 - USDA.

text.p: Interior Iowa/southern Minnesota hog marketings Friday were estimated at 105,000 head, compared with 111,000 a week ago and 109,000 a year ago, USDA said. Saturdays estimate was 15,000 head, compared with 13,000 a week ago and 71,000 a year ago.

Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts were steady to $0.50 per cwt higher than midsession Thursday. Trade was slow to moderate for moderate to good demand and light to moderate offerings.
Northern area iced up and movement hampered.

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts $1.50-$2.00 per cwt higher. Sows steady to 4.00 higher. Receipts this week 541,000 last week 570,000, last year 619,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending Nov. 9, 1996 254.5 lbs compared to 253.7 lbs previous week 253.6 lbs last year.
